title: Add behavioral self-clone / identical-candidate guard to differential_fuzz so A-vs-A cannot score a pass
acceptance_criteria: A new top-level helper _candidates_are_self_clone(code_a, code_b) -> bool is added at module scope in harness/diff_fuzzer.py.

_candidates_are_self_clone returns True when code_a is code_b OR both parse and ast.dump(ast.parse(code_a)) == ast.dump(ast.parse(code_b)); it is fail-soft (never raises; on parse failure falls back to identity/stripped-string compare and returns False so the normal differential proceeds).

differential_fuzz calls the guard at the top (before the batch_config dispatch) and, when self-clone is detected, returns FuzzResult(equivalent=False, total_inputs=0, matching_inputs=0, error=<non-empty self-clone message>).
The rest of differential_fuzz (the batch_config.get('enabled', True) dispatch to _fuzz_batch / _fuzz_sequential) is unchanged below the new guard.
_fuzz_batch, _fuzz_sequential, fuzz_from_task, FuzzResult and all strategy/sandbox helpers are unchanged.

The patch is a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ SYMBOL patch keyed on differential_fuzz, R-anchored on _fuzz_batch or _fuzz_sequential, that also lands _candidates_are_self_clone at module scope (no __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__).
The verification command reports N passed with N>=2 and tests/test_diff_fuzzer.py is not regressed.

spec.objective: Close the self-clone / identical-candidate vacuity at the differential engine: add a behavioral guard so a candidate pair that is the SAME source on both sides (object-identical or AST-equal, the single-agent-promotion self-clone case) returns a fail-closed FuzzResult instead of a vacuous equivalent=True. This is purely additive: one new top-level helper plus a minimal guard call at the top of differential_fuzz, leaving the dispatch and all other helpers byte-identical.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW top-level helper _candidates_are_self_clone(code_a: str, code_b: str) -> bool that returns True when code_a is code_b (object identity, the literal self-clone assignment) OR when both sides parse and their normalized ASTs are equal (ast.dump(ast.parse(code_a)) == ast.dump(ast.parse(code_b))).

Make the helper fail-soft: if either side does not parse, fall back to the identity / stripped-string comparison and NEVER raise; a parse failure must return False so the normal differential proceeds and surfaces the real error.

At the TOP of differential_fuzz, before the batch_config dispatch, call the guard: if _candidates_are_self_clone(code_a, code_b) is True, RETURN FuzzResult(equivalent=False, total_inputs=0, matching_inputs=0, error='self-clone: code_a and code_b are the same submission; a differential check over identical candidates is vacuous and cannot certify equivalence').

Keep the remainder of differential_fuzz byte-identical (the batch_config.get('enabled', True) dispatch to _fuzz_batch / _fuzz_sequential) and ensure the guard rejects ANY self-clone pair while never rejecting a genuine distinct pair that merely agrees on the fuzzed outputs.
spec.interfaces: Adds top-level def _candidates_are_self_clone(code_a: str, code_b: str) -> bool(code_a: str, code_b: str) -> bool to harness/diff_fuzzer.py and inserts a guard call at the top of def differential_fuzz(code_a: str, code_b: str, func_name: str, config: dict[str, Any], session_id: str='default') -> FuzzResult(code_a: str, code_b: str, func_name: str, config: dict[str, Any], session_id: str='default') -> FuzzResult. Returns the existing FuzzResult dataclass (equivalent, total_inputs, matching_inputs, failures, error, skipped_reason). The error-bearing non-equivalent FuzzResult is treated by orchestrator_worker.main as fuzz_error_r1 (REJECT) — the correct fail-closed outcome for a self-cloned candidate.
edge_cases: Object identity (code_a is code_b) must short-circuit True without parsing, mirroring the worker's agent_a_code = agent_b_code = present_code assignment.
AST-equal but byte-different sources (comment/whitespace round-trip) must be caught via ast.dump(ast.parse(...)) equality.
Either side failing to parse must NOT raise: fall back to identity / stripped-string compare and return False so the real differential runs and surfaces the genuine error.
A genuine distinct pair (different source, same func_name) that happens to agree on fuzzed outputs must NOT be flagged as a self-clone; only literally-same or AST-equal source is refused.
Do NOT key the guard on any task field, task_id, or hardcoded code string; it must be general.
non_goals: No integration test and no orchestrator/worker pipeline run; integration coverage is explicitly excused for this brief and verification is a scoped pytest selection.

Do NOT add a byte A==B check as the teeth; the guard is behavioral/structural (identity OR AST-equal), since a byte compare misses AST-equal self-clones and would not catch the p11-style class anyway.
Do NOT alter _fuzz_batch, _fuzz_sequential, fuzz_from_task, the FuzzResult dataclass shape, the sandbox, the input-strategy builder, or the _generate_inputs contract.
Do NOT add a held-out SPEC / spec-vs-candidate oracle (out of scope); this impl only closes the self-clone class, and does NOT edit harness/orchestrator_worker.py or harness/orchestrator.py.
spec.implementation_notes:
Read harness/diff_fuzzer.py first. Emit a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ SYMBOL patch keyed on the top-level differential_fuzz, R-ANCHORED on an existing top-level symbol (_fuzz_batch or _fuzz_sequential), so the new _candidates_are_self_clone helper lands at module scope alongside the reproduced differential_fuzz (the enclosing-symbol/anchor path reliably lands a new module-level symbol; a standalone unanchored new-symbol patch fails patch-apply with an opaque auto_commit_failed). Do NOT emit __JANUSMASK_MANIFEST__. ast is already importable in the module (or import it within the helper). The dispatch body below the guard stays exactly: batch_config = config.get('batch_execution', {}); if batch_config.get('enabled', True): return _fuzz_batch(...); return _fuzz_sequential(...). Depends on restore-fuzz-self-clone-guard-oracle (RED-before, GREEN-after). Run the exact scoped vcmd before dispatch and confirm N passed with N>=2 and that tests/test_diff_fuzzer.py is not regressed.

                "function_level_inputs": 50,

        code = "def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:\n    return a + b\n"
        result = differential_fuzz(code, code, "add", fast_config, session_id="eq_test")
        assert result.equivalent is True
        assert len(result.failures) == 0

    def test_different_implementations_divergent(self, fast_config):
        code_a = "def abs_val(x: int) -> int:\n    return x if x >= 0 else -x\n"
        code_b = "def abs_val(x: int) -> int:\n    return x\n"
        result = differential_fuzz(code_a, code_b, "abs_val", fast_config, session_id="div_test")
        assert result.equivalent is False
        assert len(result.failures) > 0

    def test_syntax_error_returns_error(self, fast_config):
        code_a = "def foo(: pass\n"
        code_b = "def foo(): pass\n"
        result = differential_fuzz(code_a, code_b, "foo", fast_config, session_id="syn_test")
        assert result.equivalent is False
        assert result.error is not None

    def test_failures_capped(self, fast_config):
        code_a = "def ident(x: int) -> int:\n    return x\n"
        code_b = "def ident(x: int) -> int:\n    return x + 1\n"
        result = differential_fuzz(code_a, code_b, "ident", fast_config, session_id="cap_test")
        assert len(result.failures) <= 20

        task = {
            "task_id": "t1",
            "constraints": {
                "function_signature": "def add(a: int, b: int) -> int",
            },
        }
        result = fuzz_from_task(code, code, task, fast_config, session_id="task_test")
        assert result.equivalent is True
